_doc: VOLTA Research config. Phase 1 is read-only and never downloads: the inventory is a stat-only walk (readdir + lstat).
A file with blocks === 0 and size > 0 is a dataless iCloud placeholder. Its contents are never read; the UI shows a copyable `brctl download` command instead.
roots[]: { id, label, path (~ ok), enabled, excludeDirs? }. excludeDirs are folder names (case-insensitive) skipped inside that root, on top of the global excludeDirNames / excludeDirPatterns.
excludeDirPatterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against a folder name. The default pattern skips image folders (images, figures, screenshots, thumbnails...).
stageA.mirrorPrefixes maps the paths Voltamachine recorded (/Volumes/Voltamachina/...) to a root id, so a Stage A record joins the same file under ~/Documents by relative path.
indexPath: the persisted inventory. Lives on Windsor, never on the boot disk (the disk is tight).
graphs[].dir: graphify-out copies on Windsor. The originals under ~/Documents/PROJECTS/ErisMornCloud are iCloud and get evicted (Optimize Mac Storage), which emptied Threads.

phase2: embeddings of every library row (title, folder path, Stage A tags/summary/claims, the head of local md/txt files) in Windsor. embedUrl is any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings server (Ollama :11434 or LM Studio :1234). labelTask is the config/llm-routes.json task that names clusters from their titles ("quick": local first, then OmniRoute); "" keeps term labels only. Nothing is downloaded from iCloud.
